blind.description: A stylized potted mandrake plant featuring a classic reddish-terracotta clay pot, a pale tan root-like bulb nestled inside, a cluster of broad green leaves spreading outwards from the crown, and a pair of small purple berries at the center. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and clean with stylized hand-painted textures, sitting flat on the ground via the pot's base.
blind.from_above: A circular orange rim enclosing tan root/soil and a star-like rosette of broad green leaves with two small purple berries in the middle, casting an elongated leafy shadow to the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 as tall as the figure (approx. 10 to 12 inches tall), with a foliage spread of roughly 8 to 10 inches wide.
